tweets.text: Loop Capital initiated coverage on $RBRK with a Buy rating and a $100 price target. According to analyst Yun Kim, cyber resilience represents a major secular growth opportunity, reinforced by developments such as Mythos and Hugging Face. As agentic AI adoption accelerates, Rubrik is positioned to be one of the key beneficiaries. Despite near-term hardware supply constraints, demand should remain strong as cyber resilience becomes essential for AI-driven workflows. Loop also believes Rubrik’s go-to-market execution gives it an edge over competitors. The firm’s DCF-based price target reflects premium multiples typically assigned to high-growth software companies. Rubrik appears well positioned to benefit from the next wave of AI security.

$SKHY and $SNDK have announced the first open High Bandwidth Flash (HBF) standard, creating a new memory tier between HBM and SSDs. It delivers up to 512 GB of capacity and 3.0 TB/s of bandwidth. By combining near-HBM speeds with NAND-level capacity, HBF could help solve one of AI’s biggest bottlenecks: memory bandwidth and capacity limitations. A potentially significant development for next-generation AI infrastructure.

Jeff Bezos’ stock sale is making headlines, but the reality is far less dramatic. Out of roughly 881 million Amazon $AMZN shares he owns, he’s planning to sell about 15 million shares—just 1.7% of his total stake. In other words, he’s not dumping his shares. This isn’t a sudden decision either. The sale is being executed under a pre-arranged 10b5-1 trading plan, a common way for founders to diversify their wealth, fund philanthropy, or invest elsewhere. Instead of focusing on planned insider sales, pay attention to what actually matters: AWS growth, advertising revenue, free cash flow, profitability, and the company’s long-term fundamentals. Don’t get distracted by headlines. Planned founder sales are noise—the business fundamentals are what really matter.
We didn’t make any changes to the portfolio today, and it’s up 8.34%.

$META has been invited to the White House on Tuesday. The company will meet with the U.S. government to discuss AI safety testing, a Meta spokesperson confirmed to Reuters. The move highlights the active involvement of major technology companies in the regulatory process and could mark an important step toward establishing AI safety standards.

Trump: Talks with Iran are continuing, despite Tehran’s explicit denial. He once again emphasized that Iran will never be allowed to obtain a nuclear weapon. The statement has raised hopes of easing tensions, suggesting that diplomacy is still alive.

$ASTS: Rakuten has received preliminary approval to test direct-to-cell satellite connectivity using the 700 MHz spectrum in Japan. If the official regulations and the J-LEO award are finalized in August, the path to a commercial license will open. This marks AST SpaceMobile’s first major operational step in Asia and could serve as a strong long-term catalyst.

Günaydın Güçlü bilançolar geldikçe önceden hedge için ödenen pahalı primlerin artık ödenmek istenmediğini görüyoruz. Hedging talebi azalıyor. Geçen hafta bilanço öncesinde hyperscaler hisselerinde gördüğümüz bullish küçük yatırımcı pozisyonlanmasının ardından, bu hisseler yükseldikçe perakende yatırımcılarda hem call overwriting hem de doğrudan put alımlarında artış gördük. Bu da temel olarak mevcut seviyelerden yukarı yönlü potansiyelin sınırlı olduğunu düşündürtüyor. Bugünkü AMD bilançosu öncesinde yüksek opsiyon satışı var zaten son bir ayda AMD’de ky nin açtığı işlemlerin yaklaşık %43’ü call/put satışlarından oluşuyor. IV %80 olunca herkes volatilitiden faydalanmaya çalışıyor. Anlaşılabilir bir durum.
